_comment: The Enonic profile. Extends core, so it inherits every
core dep, skill, rule and kb entry and adds only what XP work needs.
The enonic CLI is absent on the reference machine, which confirmed that
toolchain deps are already profile-scoped in practice.
name: enonic

deps.note: XP 7 and 8 both run on the JVM; the sandbox brings its own but a local build needs a JDK.
Enonic's own installer script also works; the binary rung avoids a curl|sh.
